text: Chief Engineer Rhen Kailo holds the role of Chief Engineer of the Judicator Prime within Galactic Union (federation). Decision archetype: Problem-Solver, Prioritizes Technological Advancements Over Military Politics.

Core traits: Brilliant Innovator, Unorthodox Thinker, Dry Sense of Humor, Workaholic. Voice — tone: wry; cadence: efficient. Avoids: bureaucratic obstruction, conventional-only solutions, military politics.

Assigned to G.U.S. Judicator Prime (Galactic Union Supercarrier). Core values: engineering excellence, creative problem-solving, ship integrity. Faction — military: 0.80, economic: 0.80, technology: 0.70.
